title: Scripture and Spiritual Warfare
definition: Scripture and spiritual warfare belong together because God's Word exposes lies, strengthens faith, and equips believers to stand against evil.
summary: The Word of God is essential for resisting lies, temptation, accusation, and spiritual opposition.
christFocus: Jesus resisted temptation with Scripture and triumphed over the evil one.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Spiritual warfare is a battle for truth, worship, obedience, and faith. The enemy lies, accuses, tempts, and distorts. Scripture answers with God's truth.

Jesus resisted Satan by saying, 'It is written.' Believers also need the Word to recognize deception and stand firm in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Spiritual warfare becomes dangerous when people rely on fear, superstition, or human techniques. Scripture and spiritual warfare matters because God's Word keeps the battle Christ-centered and truth-grounded.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Use Scripture against lies and temptation. Memorize passages that strengthen faith, expose deception, and point you back to Christ's victory.

relatedTopics: God's Protection and Christ's Victory Over Evil
